notes: Summary: Mid-market product org (customer support + docs) moving from Hosted POC -> evaluation of Dedicated (VPC) for data residency + control.

Use-case detail: Support chat with context windows up to 4k tokens, prioritized low-variance latency (p95 target <= 200ms for short responses). Also embeddings for semantic search across docs (throughput ~200 QPS during business hours).
POC results: Hosted API quality OK; observed token spend higher than expected. Team wants guaranteed throughput and predictable egress for compliance reasons.

Security asks captured: Provide SOC2 report (in-scope systems), SSO/SAML SSO integration guide, proof of immutable audit logs with retention controls, KMS integration for customer keys, and region residency options (primary: us-east-1).
Quoted from InfoSec: "Need architecture diagram showing VPC peering, NAT, and logging flow to our SIEM. Also want SLA for timeline on incident notification."
Routing/fallback preferences: Prefer routing to smaller model family for low-cost non-critical queries; require automatic fallback to regionally-hosted compatible model if capacity constrained.
Cost sensitivity: Moderate. Willing to commit to reserved Dedicated for 6-12 months if unit economics look favorable. Asking for uplift on token pricing compared to Hosted list for committed volume.
Legal/procurement: Needs standard DPA with data residency clause; procurement asks for 30-45 day PO lead time.
poc_milestones: Hosted POC (Jan 20 - Feb 10): baseline integration finished (chat + search).
POC metrics: avg latency 220ms for 512-token replies, cost burn $6.2k over 3 weeks, embedding throughput 150 QPS sustained in staging.
Dedicated pilot proposal: 1 reserved pool (8x A100-equivalent) + VPC endpoint, two-week pilot at reduced rate. Requested by SummitRidge on 2026-03-05.
Security deliverables requested: SOC2 report, SAML metadata, audit log schema, KMS integration guide, VPC architecture diagram.
technical_requirements: Latency SLO: p95 <= 200ms for <512-token responses (edge routing preferred)
Throughput: sustain 200 QPS for embeddings/search during peak (auto-scaling desirable)
Model preferences: open-models preferred for auditability; fallback to Redwood-verified low-cost variants for non-critical queries
Data controls: field-level redaction support, retention controls configurable per-namespace, exportable audit logs
Security: SSO/SAML, SCIM for user provisioning, customer-managed KMS, SOC2 compliance evidence
commercial_notes: ARR expectation: mid-band purchase ~$50k-150k depending on pilot results and reserved commitment
Discount ask: prefer committed pricing for 6-12 month reserved capacity; negotiate burst credits for first 30 days of migration
Billing: prefers monthly billing with PO net-30.
